Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production background illustration for Crownroad, a medieval fantasy strategy game, widescreen 16:9.
Primary request: Beautiful painterly premium game key art of the Lantern Caravan camp at blue-hour dusk. A fortified wooden war wagon with warm glowing brass lanterns sits on the right third beside a small campfire, a royal teal pennant, stacked supplies and swords. A winding road leads to a distant ruined medieval castle in misty mountains. Rich atmospheric depth, meticulous hand-painted illustration, restrained detail, cinematic composition. Modern art-directed medieval fantasy, elegant and believable, not cartoon mobile clipart.
Composition: landscape 1536x1024 or wider, main wagon in right half, left half mostly dark quiet forest and mist with generous dark negative space for UI. Lower quarter dark foreground grass. Colors midnight forest green, slate blue, antique gold and warm amber lights. No text, letters, UI, border, watermark or logos.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: single production portrait atlas texture for a medieval strategy game. EXACT uniform 4 columns by 3 rows grid, 12 square cells, total 1536x1152 pixels. Each cell filled edge-to-edge with a separate centered bust portrait on dark desaturated teal background. No gaps, no gutters, no borders, NO TEXT. The game will sample each equal cell as a unit portrait. Premium hand-painted fantasy oil illustration, elegant antique gold highlights, realistic detailed armor, warm lantern light. Consistent crop head and upper chest, all faces centered within their own square with generous inner margins. Left to right top to bottom: row 1 (1) male swordsman in open steel sallet, (2) female hooded archer with bow, (3) heavy shield knight in closed greathelm, (4) spearman with kettle helmet; row 2 (5) crossbowman in leather hood, (6) cavalry rider in plumed helmet, (7) middle-aged siege engineer with leather apron, (8) elderly mage with pale beard and blue hood; row 3 (9) halberdier in engraved armor, (10) female alchemist with amber potion, (11) battle monk in ochre robes, (12) undead grave lord with bone crown and green glowing eyes. No modern items, no text or logos.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production background for a 2D medieval lane battle game, widescreen 16:9 landscape.
Primary request: A beautiful hand-painted deserted medieval pilgrim road battlefield outside a ruined hilltop castle. Elevated oblique side view looking north over a very broad flat grassy battle clearing. Dark forest and misty mountains with ruined castle in the distant upper third, dawn amber sun rays against desaturated teal shadows. From left to right the playable middle half must be unobstructed, gently textured muted green-brown level ground with a horizontal dirt road and scattered tiny stones, readable silhouettes will be rendered on top by game. The bottom sixth is dark foreground grasses for UI. Premium painterly strategy game environment art, highly atmospheric, detailed distant background, restrained unobtrusive ground. NO characters, no soldiers, no wagons, no large foreground buildings, no text, no interface or logos. Exactly flat horizontal fighting ground from left to right, not a perspective road disappearing toward the center.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: an unlabeled world-map background for a medieval strategy game, landscape 4:3 aspect ratio. A beautifully illustrated old cartographer's map of a fallen kingdom, viewed perfectly from above. Dark desaturated forest-green land, finely inked hills, clusters of tiny evergreen forests, winding amber roads and pale blue-green rivers, distant mountain ridges along top edge, a small castle near far right, tiny hamlets scattered along road. Restrained aged parchment grain, muted antique gold linework, richly detailed but calm premium fantasy art. Main central and lower land mass has open negative space for six interactive stage nodes that the game draws on top. Top left corner is relatively calm and dark for an in-game chapter label. Edge-to-edge image, no frame, no UI, absolutely NO TEXT, lettering, numbers, dots, pins, labels or legend. No perspective, no photorealistic terrain, no modern streets.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: a single 2-cell sprite atlas with a genuinely transparent background for a medieval fantasy 2D side-view battle game. Wide 1536x1024 canvas, EXACTLY two equal half-width cells, left and right, no overlap. Left cell: an ornate medieval wooden armored war wagon viewed from its side, facing right, iron wheels, teal pennant, brass lantern glowing warm amber, no horses. Right cell: a ruined stone gatehouse of the undead host, tall angular stone tower, closed iron gate, tattered burgundy banner and subtle eerie green braziers. Both centered in own half-cell with at least 12 percent transparent padding at all sides. Both objects stand on same bottom baseline at 88 percent of canvas height. Hand-painted premium 2D strategy game sprites, realistic material detail with strongly readable silhouettes at small sizes, muted stone and timber colors, antique gold details. Orthographic side elevation with slight depth, matching a painterly dark fantasy game. No environment, ground plane, drop shadow rectangle, UI, lettering, border, or watermark. Actual alpha transparency around both isolated objects.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one transparent unit sprite atlas for a medieval 2D lane battle game, EXACT 3 columns by 2 rows of equal cells, 1536x1024 pixels. SIX isolated full-body game characters, one centered per equal cell, all six facing RIGHT in a side-on three-quarter view. No scenery, no labels, no divider lines. ACTUAL transparent alpha background. Every character is fully contained in its own cell with 15 percent transparent padding on every side. Baseline at 85 percent of each cell height. Row 1 left-to-right: steel-armored swordsman with teal tabard and short sword; female archer in dark green hood holding a wooden bow; bulky closed-helmet shield knight with large teal shield and sword. Row 2 left-to-right: ragged undead risen soldier in rusty mail holding a broken sword; crouching fast ghoul with pale sickly skin and torn dark rags; towering grave brute in jagged black armor with two-handed axe. Premium hand-painted 2D strategy sprites, readable silhouettes at 64px, muted natural material colors with gold rim light, consistent slightly stylized proportions and lighting, detailed medieval fantasy, NO chibi, no text, no modern items. Transparent background only.
